payload.consequence: Three entries were rewritten and one verification pass was spent before the glossary landed. No incorrect definition reached the committed file and nothing consumed the entries in their incorrect form; the verification that established this was run, so the effect is observed rather than undetermined.
payload.expected: domain-modeling requires checking for an authoritative upstream glossary before writing terms into a fresh CONTEXT.md, matching an existing file's consistent shape, keeping definitions tight and free of implementation detail, and offering an ADR only when all three of its tests hold.
payload.observed: Those were followed: the upstream check produced a deference rule to docs/principles/, a sibling repository's house style was matched, one ADR was offered against the three-part test and written on approval, and docs/agents/domain.md was co-edited. Three of the 27 glossary entries were nonetheless incorrect as first written — gate state listed four values where the published schema defines eight and included a field name that is not a state, authorization reason was described using values belonging to review_reentry_basis, and skill key was described as a plain path derivation. All three were corrected after a verification pass against src/lib.rs and the schema.
payload.run_condition: The use produced a 27-term glossary across five clusters plus one ADR, inside a session of roughly sixty turns across four repositories. The three incorrect entries were written in one drafting pass and caught in a verification pass immediately after it, before the file was committed.

payload.consequence: Undetermined. The full read is itself the check that would have revealed whether the amendment duplicates or conflicts with a term defined in the unread Gate or Review sections. Targeted greps for installed/shipped-set vocabulary across CONTEXT.md and docs/principles/ returned no competing definition, but that is narrower than the prescribed read.
payload.expected: Companion-mode guidance owes a full read of the governing CONTEXT.md before challenging or amending an existing term; a targeted check suffices only when no existing term is challenged.
payload.observed: The glossary was read in parts only - preamble and deference rule, section headings via grep, and the Identity and Distribution sections - while the Gate and Review sections were never read. The existing Skill package term was then challenged as under-specified and amended.
payload.run_condition: Companion-mode use alongside grilling across a five-fork triage session; the glossary check ran early and the amendment landed in the ratified batch near the end, and the deviation was surfaced by this capture pass rather than by any step or gate during the run.
payload.workaround_taken: Targeted greps of the section index and of installed/shipped-set vocabulary substituted for the full glossary read.

payload.consequence: The posted brief carries a load-bearing term the governing glossary does not define, and creation of that entry was moved into the brief's own acceptance criteria, so it lands only if the work lands. Three consumer repositories defer to this glossary for lifecycle vocabulary and find no definition in the interim. No rework and no incorrect artifact; the departure and its reason were disclosed in the session's final summary.
payload.expected: Per the rule that pending glossary updates flush before publishing a durable deliverable that leans on a newly-resolved term, the term Withdrawal — used throughout the posted agent brief as the name of the operation — would have been written into CONTEXT.md before that brief was posted.
payload.observed: The write was declined. CONTEXT.md received only Orphaned package, which describes present state. Withdrawal names an operation absent from the codebase, and docs/principles/inherited-prohibitions.md forbids leaving unadopted design active in the tree or in default agent context. The brief was posted using the term with no glossary entry behind it.
payload.run_condition: Companion-mode use alongside one grilling run on a single issue, yielding one glossary entry and one deferred ADR; the conflict surfaced late, at the pre-publication flush check immediately before the brief was posted and the glossary committed, and was caught by that flush check rather than by anything downstream.
payload.workaround_taken: Substituted an acceptance criterion in the agent brief requiring the Withdrawal entry at implementation time, in place of the glossary write the instruction called for.

payload.consequence: The amendment was written into the posted agent brief as an instruction to amend the ADR in place with an 'Amended:' line, leaving the revision identifier and the companion note unresolved for the implementing agent. Whether that is sufficient is not determinable from this session: the check that would show it is an agent working the brief, and it has not run. The glossary half of the same use — two new terms and one sharpened — landed unaffected.
payload.expected: Per its ADR-format reference, refining an accepted ADR whose decision still stands is recorded in place with an 'Amended: <date> (<revision>) — <what changed>' line, and noted wherever the repository already records the revision, such as its changelog or iteration report.
payload.observed: This repository has no changelog and no iteration report, and its constitution explicitly declines to maintain a changelog as an obligation. Its ADRs are anchored by acceptance date and issue number rather than by any revision identifier, and the ADR directory holds no prior amendment to copy. Both the revision field of the prescribed line and the companion note it calls for therefore had no available value or destination here.
payload.run_condition: Companion-mode use alongside a four-fork grilling inside a longer triage session, covering one glossary file and one ADR decision. The glossary work completed without incident; the gap surfaced late, only when the amendment mechanics were consulted while assembling the closing recap and the agent brief, and was noticed during drafting rather than caught by any gate.
payload.workaround_taken: Deferred the unresolved amendment mechanics into the agent brief instead of settling them, and omitted the companion note for want of any artifact in this repository to write it to.

payload.consequence: Undetermined. The unread reference is itself the check that would have shown whether the entry conforms to the prescribed format, so whether it deviates cannot be established from this session; a conformance claim here would rest on the neighbouring entries rather than on the format spec. No rework has occurred, and the entry is uncommitted and revisable.
payload.expected: When a resolved term is written into CONTEXT.md, the skill directs the author to use the format defined in its CONTEXT-FORMAT.md reference, read before the entry is composed.
payload.observed: CONTEXT-FORMAT.md was not opened at any point in the session. The new glossary entry was composed by matching the shape of the neighbouring entries in the live CONTEXT.md — bold term, definition paragraph, trailing avoid-line — and written at the companion workflow's ratification gate. The omission surfaced only when the user asked which skills had run, after the entry was already in the working tree.
payload.run_condition: One top-level session of roughly fifty tool calls, in companion mode alongside a grilling interview; the skill governed one coined term and one ADR-routing decision. The omission occurred late, at the single glossary write after the maintainer's go, and was surfaced by a user question after delivery rather than by any gate in the run.
payload.workaround_taken: Composed the entry from the shape of the neighbouring glossary entries in the live file instead of from the prescribed format reference.

payload.note: All four open execution incidents occurred late in companion workflows, at glossary or ADR flush, write, or recap time after substantial context accumulation; fresh short-context blind trial executors cannot vary or witness the implicated context-distance and run-length condition.
